(259)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (259)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so//

(260)༄༅// gang sku lhun po ltar brjid 'od mtha' yas// gang gsung lha rnga tshangs dbyangs ltar snyan cing*// gang thugs shes bya kun mkhyen stobs mnga' ba// gang de'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med zhabs 'dud// de nyid rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa 'di// dpal ldan bla ma mchog gis gang gsungs pa// ma nor gsal bar ye ger bkod pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'dir bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la gsum ste/ bkod pa bshams pa dang*/ mngon rtogs bsgom pa dang*/ bdag 'jug blang ba'o// dang po bkod pa bshams pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dmar po/ phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog /mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon/ dbus su lha'i mtshan ma'am/ lha tshom bkod/ mtha' mchod pa dang gtor mas bskor/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa gzhung bzhin bcas la bzhag /kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i las bum kyang bsham/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i chas rnams kyang tshogs par bsham mo// gnyis pa bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la gnas par byas la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi dang mthun/ bye brag tu/ swa bhā wa 'i sngags kyi stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams yongs su dag pa/ pad+ma rā ga las grub pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba de nyid kyi dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri/ rma byas btegs pa'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa/ de nyid dbus su rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ (261)tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar ba/

zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus shangs dkyus ring zhing*/ dpral bar yangs pa/ mdzod spu dkar pos brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ ral pa'i zar bu 'phyang ba/ rin po che lngas rtse bran dang*/ snyan cha mgul rgyan do shal dpung rgyan dang phyag gdub sku rags dang zhabs gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan du mas kun nas mdzes pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus kun nas mdzes par yongs su brgyan pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'od zer gyis snang bar byed pa'i bdag nyid du gyur par bsam la/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od 'phros/ bde ba can nas rang lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la rang dang dbyer med du bstim/ slar 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sgrib pa dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor 'od dpag med la sogs rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying gar pad zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥyig dmar po la gzungs ring gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod la phog pas gzhal yas khang (262)nang bcud la phog pas 'od dpag med du gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim/ thugs khar 'khor bar bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// tshul 'di nyid kyis mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed gnyis ka bsgrub bo// las bum gyi nang du pad nyid steng du hrīḥlas rta mgrin dmar po zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ g.yas dbyug to/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ zhal gdangs shing dkar ba'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/

smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser du yod pa/ dbu skra khams ser spyi bor 'khyil ba/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher zhing rngog ma le brgan bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can du bsam la/ de la ye shes pa bstim/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis rgyas gdab/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang rnal rgyal bum pa'i lha'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor zhing thugs rgyud bskul nas sngags gsung zhing sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la bsnyen pa brgya skor la sogs bskyal lo// slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ las bum gyi lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba sogs gong bzhin la/ rta mgrin thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ha h+ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa// ces pas bskor bar bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// slar de dag la (263)mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma phul la gsol ba gdab/ de nas las bum gyi lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam la/ bum chus khrus byas la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pa bzhi ting nge 'dzin gyis bdag 'jug blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus byas nas gral la 'khod de/ bgegs gtor btang zhing bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bla ma la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ thal mo sbyor la nga'i rjes zlos mdzod cig / ces brjod la/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi//

zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byin/ de nas sems skyed kyi sdom pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas par 'gyur// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung ngo*// de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i (264)mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum bya'o// de dag gis sngon 'gro rnams song nas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang lnga las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon tu gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye/ ston pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag tshe dpag med// bdag cag 'khor bas 'jigs shing thugs rjes bzung du gsol// mun par gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i grong khyer na// 'jigs shing ya nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs// bde ba chen po mya ngan 'das pa'i grong*// zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing rjes gnang stsal du gsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin pa ni/ bdag gi thugs rje'i nyi ma yi// 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab//

ces brjod do// de nas slob ma rnams a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang nas/ tshe dpag med mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa'i thugs kha'i hrīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas thams cad la phog pas/ thams cad tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa/ phyag mtshan gsal ba dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ bla (265)ma'i sku las kyang tshe dpag med kyi sku dpag tu med pa chad de/ slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsgom la/ me tog gtor ba'am/ yang na sku'i spyi bor bzhag la/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// oṃ hrīḥ.a mi de wa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod do// de ltar sku'i rjes gnang gi phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lus kyi gnad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug tu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku thob pa'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gong ltar btab la/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ka tshe dpag med du bskyed pa'i snying khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hrīḥ dmar po tshegs drag dang bcas pa la gzungs ring gis bskor bar bsam/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas sngags phreng mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba lta bu dmar shar gyis thon nas/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i hrīḥ'akhor bar dmigs la/ gzungs ring nyer gcig gi phreng ba bzung la/ rjes zlos byed du gzhug go /de nas phreng ba slob ma'i mgrin par reg ste/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa'i rig sngags 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol//

zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang de bzhin du 'don par bsgyur la brjod/ 'di la (266)gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis las/ gnas skabs su sngags kyi nus pa che zhing*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug tu ngag bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ gsol ba gong bzhin btab la/ de nas slob ma'i lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun ldan du byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hrīḥdamar po 'od 'bar ba zhig bsgom la/ de nas rang gi lus 'ja' lus su yal nas mdun gyi nam mkhar hrīḥyig la thim pa la rig pa gtad/ mthar hrīḥde nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsgom la/ sems nyid skye med blo 'das gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la ci yang mi bsam par mnyam par bzhag go /de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// 'di la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis las/ gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i gnas lugs mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// bzhi pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gong ltar btab/ de nas slob ma 'od dpag med gsal bar bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi rnam rgyal bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bum pa'i nang gi tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhugs/ lus kyi nang gi sdig sgrib thams cad (267)dag nas/ lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dmar chil gyis gang bar bsam la bum pas dbang bskur zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ hrīḥ.a mi de wa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ bum chu 'thung du yang gzhug go /slob ma mnyam bzhag byas pa'i lag tu bum pa bzhag la/

bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'di khyed rang la byin pas/ 'chi med tshe 'di dngos grub thob nas/ 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang mngon du byed par bsgoms shig / ces brjod la bum chu 'thung du gzhug go / de ni yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*// 'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mtha' dag thob par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// lnga pa phrin las kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gong ltar btab/ de nas slob ma 'od dpag med gsal bar bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis rin po che'i srog zhu slob ma'i spyi bor 'ching*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis lus la brgyan/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bkab la/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs/ longs sku'i yon tan mtha' dag mtha' yas pas brgyan par bsam mo// 'di dag gi phan yon ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub cing*/ sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'bad med (268)lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod do// de nas bla ma la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod bran du// khyed la bdag nyid 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// ces lan gsum brjod la/ bla ma la phyag gsum btsal la/ bka' drin che'o// zhes brjod/ gsum pa rjes ni/ gtang rag gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/

las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de nas dpon slob rnams dga' ston la longs spyod do// tshul 'di bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// ma nor ma 'chug don rnams yongs rdzogs par// rnal 'byor 'od dpag rdo rje zhes bya bas// gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas yi ger bkod// dge bas 'gro rnams 'od dpag med thob shog// /dge legs 'phel/
